features.title: Features Designed for Every Listener
features.f1_desc: Bypass standard Android mixer limits. Stream pure high-resolution audio directly to USB DACs with DSD support and per-device volume memory.

features.f3_desc: Detect fake lossless and upsampled files using in-app spectral cutoff analysis, dynamic range calculation, and bit-depth inspection.
features.f4_desc: Enjoy word-by-word progressive lyrics highlighting, simultaneous Romaji/Romaja and translation trees, and community lyrics contributions.

guide.title: User Guide
guide.subtitle: Welcome to the official documentation for MF Music Player. Here you'll find everything you need to know to get the most out of your audio experience.

s1.desc: MF Music Player is designed to play your local music collection with absolute pristine quality. To start:
s1.l1: Install the application on your Android device directly from Google Play.
s1.l2: Grant storage permissions so the app can scan your local music library.
s1.l3: Wait for the initial scan to complete. High-resolution FLAC and ALAC files are fully supported.

s2.desc: The application interface is fully customizable to your liking. Head to Settings > Appearance to explore:
s2.l1_desc: Decide which screen you want to see first when opening the app.
s2.l2_desc: Choose between Dark mode, Light mode, or automatically follow your System theme.
s2.l3_desc: A sleek Now Playing screen inspired by the aesthetics of Apple Music.
s2.l4_desc: A beautiful alternative layout featuring a circular album art design.
s2.l5_desc: Dynamically extracts colors from the currently playing album art using the Material 3 algorithm and applies them as the app's primary color.
s2.l6_desc: Customize your bottom bar to only show the shortcuts you actually use.
s2.l7_desc: Choose between a detailed list or a visually rich grid layout depending on your preference.
s2.l8_desc: Switch between standard Material 3 dynamic themes, expressive Neobrutalism, or GPU-accelerated Claymorphic 3D inner emboss shaders.
s2.l9_desc: Customize which sections appear on your Home screen and rearrange their display order to suit your listening workflow.
s2.l10_desc: Add Android Glance widgets to your home screen with Modern and Round layouts featuring cached album artwork.

s3.desc1: MF Android bypasses standard Android audio limits to deliver Bit-Perfect playback directly to your DAC.
s3.desc2: Head to Settings > Audio Engine to enable exclusive mode, which locks the sample rate to perfectly match the source file.
s3.attn_desc1: For USB DACs without hardware volume control, we've built in Digital Attenuation to protect your ears. The app smartly remembers your last used volume for each specific USB DAC, allowing you to seamlessly and safely switch between DACs with or without hardware volume controls.
s3.attn_desc2: If your DAC does have its own hardware volume control, you can push the app's digital attenuation slider to 0dB (Max) and disable volume safety to achieve true, unadulterated Bit-Perfect audio.
s3.attn_warn_desc: Always exercise caution when initializing a DAC. Make sure you don't put on your IEMs or headphones before playing the first track to avoid any unexpected bursts of loud volume!

s4.desc1: Keep your music library looking pristine. If you have missing or incorrect album or artist covers, you can easily update them.
s4.desc2: Navigate to any Album or Artist details page. Tap the 3-dots menu button located at the bottom corner of the cover image, and select 'Edit Artwork' to search online databases (like Deezer or Last.fm) and instantly replace them with high-quality images.
s4.desc3: Backup & Restore: Secure your library configuration at any time. Go to Settings > Backup & Restore to export your playlists, favorites, and app settings to a local JSON file, or restore them instantly when switching devices.
s4.desc4: SAF Scoped Storage: When saving album covers or writing embedded lyrics tags, Mellifluous uses standard Android Storage Access Framework (SAF) folder permissions. Your files are updated cleanly without requiring invasive legacy storage permissions.
s4.l1_desc: Browse your music directly by raw folders on your storage.
s4.l2_desc: Create, edit, and manage custom playlists natively within the app.
s4.l3_desc: Import standard M3U and M3U8 playlist files directly. If duplicate tracks or missing files are detected, a smart resolution dialog helps you match or skip entries cleanly.
s4.l4_desc: Quickly scrub through thousands of tracks, albums, or artists using the responsive alphabet index on the right edge of your library lists.
s4.l5_desc: Inspect exact file containers, bitrates, sample rates, and edit embedded ID3 or Vorbis tags directly.

s5.desc1: The app supports standard embedded lyrics and online lyrics providers like Lrclib and Netease.
s5.desc2: To configure providers, go to Settings > Lyrics Provider and prioritize your preferred sources. Synchronized lyrics (.lrc) will automatically scroll along with your music.
s5.desc3: Beyond standard lyrics, MFAndroid boasts powerful plugin and tag-writing support:
s5.l1_desc: Enable on-device machine learning translation to instantly translate foreign lyrics into your native language.
s5.l2_desc: Convert Kanji or Hangul lyrics into readable Romaji/Romaja formats while you listen, powered by on-device dynamic modules.
s5.l3_desc: Embed synchronized .lrc lyrics directly into your audio file metadata (ID3v2, FLAC, MP4 tags). Once embedded, your lyrics travel permanently with your music files.
s5.l4_desc: For enhanced lyrics tracks, the player highlights words progressively in real-time matching vocal delivery, complete with optical depth-of-field blur on inactive lines.
s5.l5_desc: Displays original lyrics, romanization (│), and translation (└) simultaneously in a structured hierarchy.
s5.l6_desc: Found missing or desynced lyrics? Submit corrections or new LRC files directly to the Mellifluous community lyrics engine anonymously or with your contributor profile.
s5.l7_desc: Select lyrics lines and generate styled cards featuring album art and audio format emblems ready to share on social media.

s6.desc1: MFAndroid gives you full control over what you're listening to.
s6.l1_desc: Easily view and reorder your upcoming tracks in the Queue Bottom Sheet.
s6.l2_desc: Set a sleep timer to automatically stop playback after a set time or when the current track finishes.
s6.l3_desc: Stream your local audio files directly to Chromecast, Nest speakers, or Android TVs via an embedded local HTTP partial content server.
s6.l4_desc: Enjoy seamless transitions between tracks without silence gaps, or enable customizable crossfades for smooth transitions.
s6.l5_desc: Control playback with inline headset buttons: single-click toggles play/pause, double-click skips to next track, and triple-click returns to previous track.
s6.l6_desc: Automatically silence notification chimes and ringtones during active listening sessions to preserve focus and audio fidelity.

s7.desc1: Extend the functionality of MF Player by downloading optional dynamic modules. These modules integrate seamlessly into the main app via Play Feature Delivery and operate entirely on-device to respect your privacy.
s7.rom_desc: Powered by the Kuromoji tokenizer, this module parses Japanese text (Kanji, Hiragana, Katakana) and converts it to readable Romaji. It's perfect for singing along to Japanese tracks even if you don't read the language.
s7.trans_desc: Leveraging Google's ML Kit, this module provides on-device machine translation for your lyrics. You can use the dedicated Settings UI to select your preferred Source Language (default: Japanese) and Target Language (default: English). Translation models are dynamically downloaded in the background.
s7.coreaudio_desc: A high-performance C++ audio engine providing direct USB driver communication for bit-perfect UAC2 playback and native DSD output.
s7.warn_p1: These modules are downloaded on-demand only when you choose to use them.
s7.warn_p2: Downloading these modules will increase the app's storage footprint due to the ML Kit translation models and the comprehensive Kuromoji dictionary.
s7.warn_p3: You can free up space at any time by deleting the modules and downloaded models directly from the app settings when you no longer need them.

s8.desc1: Our Smart Audio transforms how you listen to your local library by acting as a personalized DJ. Here's a breakdown of the capabilities:
s8.f1_desc: When your current song, album, or playlist finishes, playback won't stop. The app automatically continues queuing tracks from your library that match the BPM and energy of the last song you played. It works completely in the background without needing any manual setup.
s8.f2_desc: On the Home tab, you'll see dynamically generated 'Smart Mood' cards (for example, '140 BPM • Organic • Punchy'). The app analyzes the audio characteristics of your local files to automatically group them into these stations. Tapping a card immediately shuffles tracks that fit that specific vibe.
s8.f3_desc: The more you listen, the smarter the app gets. Whenever you let a song play naturally into the next, it remembers that transition. Over time, Endless Radio relies less on BPM algorithms and more on your actual listening habits to predict what you want to hear next.

s9.desc1: MfLink lets you broadcast playback from your Android phone across your local Wi-Fi or hotspot network to any device with a modern web browser.
s9.desc2: Unlike cloud streaming services, MfLink operates 100% locally on your network. Your music files never touch an external server.
s9.f1_desc: Mellifluous embeds a lightweight coroutine-based HTTP server supporting HTTP 206 Partial Content range requests, allowing smooth seeking and full bit-perfect audio streaming to remote clients.
s9.f2_desc: MfLink advertises itself over mDNS under the service type _mflink._tcp. Compatible devices and browsers on the same subnet can automatically discover active broadcast sessions.
s9.f3_desc: The built-in web player served at the broadcast IP provides an Adaptive Focus layout (side-by-side desktop layout and toggleable mobile view), walking word-by-word progressive lyrics at 60fps, and optical depth-of-field blur.
s9.f4_desc: You can toggle 'Allow Guest Control' in the broadcast sheet. When enabled, connected web listeners can play, pause, seek, and skip tracks. When disabled, the web interface functions in read-only listen mode.
s9.f5_desc: MfLink binds to your local IPv4 address and only accepts connections within your Wi-Fi or hotspot subnet. No router port forwarding or internet exposure is required.

s10.desc1: AudioLab is a built-in diagnostic and spectral analysis tool designed for audiophiles who want to verify the true quality of their lossless music files.
s10.desc2: Many files labeled as FLAC or WAV on the internet are actually lossy MP3s that have been upscaled or re-encoded. AudioLab helps you identify these fake lossless files directly on your device.
s10.f1_desc: Lossy encoders discard inaudible high frequencies using sharp low-pass filters: 128 kbps MP3s cut off around 16 kHz, and 320 kbps MP3s cut off at 20 kHz. AudioLab calculates the frequency energy distribution to detect whether the audio contains genuine full-spectrum content above 22.05 kHz (CD quality) or 48 kHz+ (Hi-Res).
s10.f2_desc: Based on spectral rolloff and harmonic energy, AudioLab assigns clear verdicts: Genuine Lossless (true high-fidelity recording), Suspected Lossy Upsample (lossy compression artifacts detected in a lossless container), or Standard Lossy (native MP3/AAC/OGG format).
s10.f3_desc: AudioLab measures effective dynamic range (DR value) and quantization noise floors to check if 24-bit audio files possess genuine bit-depth resolution or padded zeros.
s10.f4_desc: Open the Now Playing screen, tap the audio format chip (e.g., FLAC 24-bit / 96 kHz) or select AudioLab from the 3-dots menu. The analyzer processes a sample segment and generates a detailed report.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: MF Music Player is an offline, rich features built with zero tracking and total privacy.
privacy.s1_desc: Mellifluous operates 100% locally on your Android device. We never collect, transmit, store, or share your personal information, audio files, metadata, or listening habits with any external servers.
privacy.s2_desc: We require local media reading permissions solely to scan and play your audio library. Storage Access Framework (SAF) folder permissions are requested only when you choose to edit album artwork, embed lyrics into audio files, or create local backups.
privacy.s3_desc: If you choose to search online lyrics providers (such as Lrclib or Netease), the app connects directly to those public APIs from your device to fetch synchronized lyrics. No personal identifier is sent.
privacy.s4_desc: Mellifluous contains zero third-party advertising SDKs, zero telemetry trackers, and zero background analytics services.
privacy.footer_note: If you have any questions regarding this privacy policy, please reach out via our community Discord or repository.
